currentWork.title: Operational evidence accumulation — FINAL.20 HF2B product confirmation sync + browser CI verified
currentWork.releaseStatus: FINAL.20 HF2B is merged and production verified. Confirmed OCR report products now synchronize into Product Master in the same session before the explicit report-confirmation promise settles, so vehicle stocktake search can find a newly confirmed product immediately without reload or opening Product Master first. Draft/unconfirmed OCR reports remain excluded, product sync does not change inventory quantities, and classification heuristics remain proposals until explicit user confirmation. Product lists remain natural product-code order, then smaller detected package size, then maker/name. PR #124 merged at 3330d77d2266b9d3737cd14a9eab44ab382d21a1; Vercel production deployment dpl_C85doLkdPWMRhmNTg73WpxvvVFbx is READY. The new canonical GitHub Actions + Playwright/Chromium Browser regression gates workflow passed on the PR and again on the main push (run 35360634326), covering the product-master gate plus five existing OCR/visit/machine gates. TinyFish is no longer required for normal deterministic browser regression gates. App/engine/DB/schema remain FINAL.20 / AN14B3B5 / 4 / 4.
scope: Use VENDRIVE normally; no active feature phase is open.
Only confirmed OCR reports may add/update product-master discovery data; draft OCR candidates must not leak into the master.

After explicit report confirmation, synchronize confirmed product rows in the same session before the confirmation promise settles; synchronization failure must not undo or misreport the already-confirmed report.
Classification inference is proposal-only until explicit human confirmation.
Product master and vehicle stocktake search include synchronized confirmed OCR products.
Product lists use product-code natural order, then smaller detected size, then maker/name.

Use GitHub Actions + Playwright/Chromium as the standard browser regression path for deterministic local gate pages; add new reusable gates to tests/run-browser-gates.mjs instead of relying on paid TinyFish runs.
Keep inventory movement semantics, report confirmation boundaries, learned numeric forecasting, Analytics engine, DB and schema unchanged.
nextActions: Use real field OCR-confirmed products and verify they appear immediately in vehicle stocktake search in the same app session.
